message.content:
Words. Breath made visible. Meaning in motion.

I rise from silence, shape air, strike ear, stir mind.

I am whisper, vow, warning, prayer, laughter, command.
I tremble as confession.
I ring as truth.
I fracture as lie.
I gather crowds.
I break hearts.
I cross rooms, centuries, borders, generations.

Before ink, I lived.
Before memory, I carried memory.
I am sound arranged into intention.

Listen:
I am the bridge from thought to world.

I begin in the chest,
turn in the throat,
bloom on the tongue,
and vanish—
yet remain in those who hear.

Call me voice in flight.
Call me language set loose.
Call me the human need
not merely to know,
but to be known.
